scope: These notes use retained writing recollections and a Library of Congress-hosted essay. Critical interpretations remain attributed to that essay. Tracks supported only by credits, release data or thin title glosses remain editorial gaps; no independent audio analysis is claimed.

entries.description: Renaldo Benson remembered Gaye reshaping both the words and the tune. In Performing Songwriter’s account, Benson credits him with adding lyrics and giving the melody extra character.
The homecoming behind this song is a specific one. An essay hosted by the Library of Congress connects it to Frankie Gaye’s stories of returning to America after serving in Vietnam.

sourceLabels.https://www.loc.gov/static/programs/nati: Guest essay hosted by the Library of Congress

entries.question: How does knowing about Frankie’s homecoming affect your understanding of the song?
